name: Crawl4AI
description: Crawler and scraper that turns websites into clean Markdown or LLM-extracted structured data, usable as a CLI, library or server.
whatItDoes: Fetches pages, including dynamic ones, and produces model-ready Markdown or answers to extraction questions. It is used to feed RAG pipelines, agents and data collection jobs.
howItWorks: An asynchronous crawler drives a headless browser, cleans the result and applies extraction strategies that may call an LLM. A command-line tool covers one-off crawls, and a Docker image runs it as an API service protected by a token.

requirements.name: Python
requirements.description: Runs the package and its setup command

requirements.name: LLM provider key
requirements.description: Only for question-style extraction, set through the config command

models: Any provider supported through its LLM config, optional
